_about: NSW Foundation Style models. y: 0 = head line, 1 = dotted middle line, 2 = baseline, 3 = tail line. Angles in degrees on screen: 0 = 3 o'clock, -90 = 12 o'clock, 90 = 6 o'clock. Going anticlockwise means the angle goes down. Each stroke is a list of segments: ["arc", cx, cy, rx, ry, fromDeg, toDeg] or ["line", x1, y1, x2, y2].

families.name: Round letters
families.move: Start at two o'clock and go anticlockwise.

families.name: Down, up and over
families.move: Straight down, back up, and over.

c.say: Start at two o'clock. Go up and around, and stop at four o'clock.

a.say: Start at two o'clock. Go around, all the way, then up and straight down.

d.say: Start at two o'clock. Go around, all the way, then up high, and straight down.

g.say: Start at two o'clock. Go around, all the way, then up, down into the basement, and hook.

o.say: Start at two o'clock. Go up and around, all the way, and join up.

q.say: Start at two o'clock. Go around, all the way, then up, down into the basement, and flick.

s.say: Start at two o'clock. Go up and around, slide across, and around the other way.
